.config/aerospace/aerospace.toml:
accordion-padding = 100
enable-normalization-flatten-containers = true
enable-normalization-opposite-orientation-for-nested-containers = false

[mode.main.binding]
alt-1 = "workspace 1"
alt-2 = "workspace 2"
alt-3 = "workspace 3"
alt-4 = "workspace 4"
alt-5 = "workspace 5"
alt-6 = "workspace 6"
alt-7 = "workspace 7"
alt-8 = "workspace 8"
alt-9 = "workspace 9"
alt-a = "layout tiles accordion"
alt-backtick = "focus-back-and-forth"
alt-h = "focus --boundaries-action stop --ignore-floating left"
alt-j = "focus --boundaries-action stop --ignore-floating down"
alt-k = "focus --boundaries-action stop --ignore-floating up"
alt-l = "focus --boundaries-action stop --ignore-floating right"
alt-shift-1 = "move-node-to-workspace 1"
alt-shift-2 = "move-node-to-workspace 2"
alt-shift-3 = "move-node-to-workspace 3"
alt-shift-4 = "move-node-to-workspace 4"
alt-shift-5 = "move-node-to-workspace 5"
alt-shift-6 = "move-node-to-workspace 6"
alt-shift-7 = "move-node-to-workspace 7"
alt-shift-8 = "move-node-to-workspace 8"
alt-shift-9 = "move-node-to-workspace 9"
alt-shift-e = "balance-sizes"
alt-shift-equal = "resize smart +50"
alt-shift-h = "join-with left"
alt-shift-j = "join-with down"
alt-shift-k = "join-with up"
alt-shift-l = "join-with right"
alt-shift-minus = "resize smart -50"
alt-tab = "workspace-back-and-forth"
ctrl-alt-shift-h = "move left"
ctrl-alt-shift-j = "move down"
ctrl-alt-shift-k = "move up"
ctrl-alt-shift-l = "move right"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout floating"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "com.apple.FaceTime"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout tiling"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "com.linear"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout tiling"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "com.microsoft.Excel"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout floating"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "com.obsproject.obs-studio"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout floating"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "com.paulsolt.SuperEasyTimerMac"

[[on-window-detected]]
run = "layout tiling"

[on-window-detected.if]
app-id = "notion.id"

[workspace-to-monitor-force-assignment]
1 = "main"
2 = "main"
3 = "main"
4 = "main"
5 = "main"
6 = "main"
7 = "main"
8 = "main"
9 = "secondary"
.config/ghostty/config:
auto-update = off
clipboard-read = allow
confirm-close-surface = false
cursor-style-blink = false
font-family = Berkeley Mono
font-size = 12
macos-option-as-alt = true
scrollbar = never
split-divider-color = 2a2a2a
theme = dark:custom-dark,light:custom-light
undo-timeout = 0
window-decoration = none
window-padding-x = 5
window-padding-y = 5
custom-shader = ~/.config/ghostty/shaders/crt.glsl
custom-shader = ~/.config/ghostty/shaders/focus-border.glsl
keybind = alt+tab=goto_split:next
keybind = cmd+a=unbind
keybind = cmd+backspace=text:\x15
keybind = cmd+down=scroll_to_bottom
keybind = cmd+enter=text:\x1b[13;9u
keybind = cmd+shift+a=toggle_command_palette
keybind = cmd+shift+r=reload_config
keybind = cmd+up=scroll_to_top
keybind = shift+alt+tab=goto_split:previous
keybind = shift+enter=text:\x1b\r
.config/starship.toml:
format = "${custom.submodule_chain}$username$hostname$localip$directory${custom.physical_dir}$git_branch$git_status$all$line_break$character"
scan_timeout = 200

[aws]
disabled = true

[buf]
disabled = true

[bun]
disabled = true

[custom.commit_age]
command = "git log -1 --format=%cr 2>/dev/null"
format = "([$output]($style) )"
ignore_timeout = true
require_repo = true
shell = [
    "sh",
    "-c",
]
style = "italic dimmed"
use_stdin = false
when = true

[custom.physical_dir]
command = "pwd -P"
format = "[$output]($style) "
ignore_timeout = true
shell = [
    "sh",
    "-c",
]
style = "dimmed"
use_stdin = false
when = '[ "$PWD" != "$(pwd -P)" ]'

[custom.submodule_chain]
command = """
sup=$(git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null); names=""
while [ -n "$sup" ]; do
  names="$(basename "$sup")${names:+ › $names}"
  sup=$(git -C "$sup" rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null)
done
printf "%s" "$names"
"""
format = "([$output ›]($style) )"
ignore_timeout = true
require_repo = true
shell = [
    "sh",
    "-c",
]
style = "dimmed"
use_stdin = false
when = true

[directory.substitutions]
"~/Projects/" = ""

[env_var.CLAUDECODE]
format = "[🤖](bold blue) "

[gcloud]
disabled = true

[git_commit]
disabled = true

[memory_usage]
disabled = false
style = "bold dimmed green"
threshold = 95

[nix_shell]
disabled = true

[nodejs]
disabled = true

[package]
disabled = true

[python]
disabled = true

[rust]
disabled = true

[shell]
disabled = false
fish_indicator = ""
format = "[$indicator]($style)"
nu_indicator = ""

[swift]
disabled = true

[typst]
disabled = true
